---
title: "Interactive figures"
description: "The interactive figures from the paper pages, in one place."
---

Each interactive figure runs in your browser on aggregate, portfolio-level results exported from the author's research materials; nothing is re-estimated on the fly. Every figure has a caption naming the manuscript and results package it comes from, a static image, and a downloadable JSON file with the exact numbers shown.

## Characteristic Geometry and Portfolio Choice

- [Figure 1: Portfolio formation under alternative factor models](/research/characteristic-geometry.qmd#figure-portfolio-formation), on the paper page, or [full width](portfolio-formation.qmd).
- [Figure 2: The rolling ruler](/research/characteristic-geometry.qmd#figure-rolling-geometry), the monthly geometry of 132 characteristics, June 1973 to November 2024.
